title: float-precision integrality detection fails at n=29
claim_falsified: naive float collapse can replace the exact Z[zeta]/(Phi_n) layer

computed.note: the exact collapse certifies the coefficients as integers; float-30 cannot separate 2cos(2pi/29) from its Galois conjugates to the required ~10^-9 accuracy

lesson: the exact layer is load-bearing; numerics only cross-check
